# VSee Health, Inc. — Form 10-Q (Q1, three months ended 3/31/2026)
## MD&A vs. Financial Statements Tie-Out Memo
Prepared 8/3/2026 · Source file: vsee10q033126.htm

---

## A. DISCREPANCIES — MD&A does not agree to the financial statements

### 1. Goodwill impairment attributed to the wrong year (Critical Accounting Policies — Goodwill, p. 53)
- **MD&A:** "During the year ended **December 31, 2025**, we determined there were triggering events… As a result, we recorded non-cash goodwill impairment charges of $56,675,210 on the consolidated statement of operations for the year ended **December 31, 2025**."
- **Authoritative:** the FY2025 10-K records the $56,675,210 impairment in **fiscal 2024**; for fiscal 2025 the Company performed a quantitative test and concluded **no impairment** was required. Both year references should be 2024.
- This misstates which audited period carries a $56.7 million charge.

### 2. Prior-year cash balance in Liquidity (p. 56)
- **MD&A:** "cash and cash equivalents, totalling $1,346,132 and **$2,327,337** as of March 31, 2026, and 2025, respectively"
- **F/S (Statement of Cash Flows):** cash at March 31, 2025 was **$410,122**. ($1,346,132 for 3/31/26 ties.)
- $2,327,337 appears nowhere in the financial statements. If the intended comparison was December 31, 2025, that figure is $5,266,286.

### 3. Bad debt expense increase (G&A narrative, p. 55)
- **MD&A:** "an increase in bad debt expense of **$286,529, or 230%**"
- **F/S (Note 2 & cash flow statement):** credit loss expense $355,794 (Q1 2026) vs. $120,919 (Q1 2025) = increase of **$234,875, or 194%**.
- Both the dollar amount and the percentage are unsupported.

### 4. Favorable movement in other income does not foot (Other (Income) Expense, p. 55) — minor
- **MD&A:** "$2,527,905 favorable movement" attributed to components of $1,404,511 + $367,809 + $617,567 + $138,020, which sum to **$2,527,907** ($2 difference). Each component individually ties to the income statement; only the stated total is off.

---

## B. ITEMS THAT CANNOT BE TRACED to the F/S (confirm support elsewhere)

- **$437,400** recurring revenue from non-renewed Tele-ICU contracts in Q1 2025 (contract-level detail).
- G&A sub-drivers: business consulting **$288,900**; investor relations **$67,912 / 74%**; legal & professional **$70,347 / 169%**; audit fee reduction **$79,778 / 33%**; accounting fees **$65,538 / 68%**; franchise tax **$62,842 / 100%**; lease expense **$36,945 / 93%** — none separately disclosed in the F/S.
- Note: the itemized G&A drivers net to **+$468,585**, which does not reconcile to the actual G&A increase of **$408,092** (nor with the corrected bad-debt figure, which nets to $416,931). At least one listed driver is wrong or the list is incomplete.

## C. Observations (not number errors)

- The MD&A introduction twice refers to "this **Annual Report**" and to a restatement "Explanatory Note to this Annual Report" — this is a Quarterly Report; the language appears carried over from the 10-K. Confirm whether the restatement reference belongs in this filing at all.
- Cash-flow table caption reads "Net cash used in **from** investing activities" (typo carried over from the 10-K).

---

**Results of operations table:** all eight lines, both periods, every change amount and percentage tie to the income statement — Revenue 3,160,185 / 3,321,485 / (161,300) / (5)% · CoR 1,962,074 / 1,461,514 / 500,560 / 34% · Gross margin 1,198,111 / 1,859,971 / (661,860) / (36)% · Opex 4,172,386 / 3,691,289 / 481,097 / 13% · Other income 397,751 / (2,114,617) / 2,512,368 / 119% · Loss before taxes (2,576,524) / (3,945,935) / 1,369,411 / 35% · Tax (23,738) / (13,505) / (10,233) / (76)% · Net loss (2,600,262) / (3,959,440) / 1,359,178 / 34% ✓
